entries.title: A calmer chat shell — built for real human conversations
entries.summary: Welcome to MindPal 5.0. We redesigned your daily companion from the ground up to feel warm, intuitive, and truly attentive. Whether you're texting your thoughts, speaking your mind, or having a live voice preview (30 minutes per day) with our expressive companion, MindPal is here to listen and reflect with you at your own pace. It is not a crisis line. Presence rooms are not in this release.
highlights: Thoughtful conversation flow — Chat that can stop whenever you need. Pause or redirect a thought in mid-air with a simple tap.
Speak your mind freely — Composer dictation lets your voice fill the composer effortlessly. Not a live voice call.
A face full of life — Live voice preview brings your companion alive. Signed-in accounts enjoy 30 minutes per day with a companion whose eyes smile, wink, soften, and share hearts with you.
Natural back-and-forth — Speak and interrupt naturally. MindPal gently fades its voice the moment you talk, keeping live captions perfectly in tune.
Instant one-tap connection — Jump straight into conversation without friction or consent walls, complete with smooth, tactile feedback on every button.
Tuned to your vibe — Personalization on each send adapts MindPal's warmth and tone to fit your mood today.
Reflections that stay with you — MindPal thoughtfully remembers your favorite topics and reflections across sessions so you can pick up right where you left off.
Focused and private — Not in this release — Presence rooms stay off so you get a dedicated, intimate 1-on-1 space.
